name: Port lookup
summary: What runs on a network port, or which port a service uses
author: friday-core
description: Looks up well-known TCP and UDP ports (SSH 22, HTTPS 443, RDP 3389, SMB 445 and more) with a safety note, and the ports FRIDAY and its tools use: the kernel on 8765, Ollama on 11434 and the Vite dev server.
